intro: An Old Colleague is an Alliance quest given by the gnome engineer Gaxim Rustfizzle in the Stonetalon Mountains. Looking to construct an extraordinarily potent device, Gaxim sends an adventurer all the way across the sea to Ironforge to track down an old acquaintance capable of synthesizing a hazardous explosive concoction. Completing this errand opens the door to procuring the volatile chemical compound known as Nitromirglyceronium.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The device I'm thinking about is my most advanced version to date. But we'll need a special potion if it's to work. I'm thinking we might as well get the good stuff since this mission could be your last.
And for that, we're going to need some potent explosives: Nitromirglyceronium.
The only person who can make NG-5 is an old friend of mine: Lomac Gearstrip. Look for him in Tinker Town.
You talk him into making us some NG-5, I'll get to work on placement for my devices.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ahhh.... Gaxim sent you, huh? How do I know you're not lying to me?! Hmm? Hmm...?
